statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the sqlite3 command-line shell's .recover command (src/shell.c.in, using the recover extension in ext/recover/sqlite3recover.c). This image ships only libsqlite3.so.0, built from the autoconf amalgamation: the sqlite3 shell is removed with the rest of /usr/local/bin, and the recover extension is not part of the library. tests/check_metadata.py fails if SQLite contributes any file other than libsqlite3.so.*, if a sqlite3 executable is present, or if libsqlite3 exports any sqlite3_recover_* or sqlite3_dbdata_init symbol.
